_doc: page_type -> shape family. Family decides which extraction instruction the LLM receives and which script gate thresholds apply. Counts are from a full census of Algolia_Prod_Copy_Enhanced on 2026-08-07 (12,114 records, 43 page_type values, no sampling). Regenerate counts, never hand-edit the mapping without recording why in chapter-3-build-log.md.

reference.what_it_is: API/SDK surface. Terse. Signatures, parameter tables, code. Prose is often one sentence.
reference.highlights_are: parameter names, method names, required-vs-optional, return shape

instructional.what_it_is: Procedures. Steps, prerequisites, troubleshooting. Longest bodies in the corpus.
instructional.abstract_must_lead_with: the task the reader can accomplish
instructional.highlights_are: prerequisites, the ordered steps, the constraint or gotcha

editorial.what_it_is: Narrative. Blog, press, gated assets. Marketing voice, buried thesis.
editorial.abstract_must_lead_with: the claim or news the piece actually makes
editorial.highlights_are: the thesis, named entities, any cited figure

commercial.what_it_is: Product, solution, pricing, competitor pages. Highest hallucination risk: the model wants to sell.
commercial.abstract_must_lead_with: the capability as the page states it, never a benefit the page implies
commercial.highlights_are: named capabilities, named tiers or limits, named integrations

evidence.what_it_is: Customer stories. Contains named customers and hard metrics. Numbers must never be paraphrased.
evidence.abstract_must_lead_with: the named customer and what they achieved
evidence.highlights_are: customer name, the metric verbatim with its unit, the product used

hub.what_it_is: Index and listing pages. Mostly links, little prose. The slop trap: nothing to say, so the model invents.
hub.abstract_must_lead_with: what the hub collects, only if the page states it in prose
hub.highlights_are: the named sections it links to, verbatim

corporate.what_it_is: Company, trust, careers, partner, department. Thin and boilerplate-heavy.
corporate.abstract_must_lead_with: the stated fact about the company or programme

excluded.what_it_is: Not enriched. Job adverts, deleted per Arijit 2026-08-07.
